claims: Ty Gibbs' father was Coy Gibbs (1972–2022).
Coy Gibbs was a former NASCAR driver.
Coy Gibbs was an assistant coach for the Washington Commanders.
Coy Gibbs was co-owner and COO of Joe Gibbs Racing.
Coy Gibbs passed away in his sleep.
Coy Gibbs passed away at age 49.
Coy Gibbs passed away on November 6, 2022.
Coy Gibbs passed away one day after watching Ty Gibbs win the 2022 NASCAR Xfinity Series Championship.
Coy Gibbs was the son of Joe Gibbs.
Joe Gibbs is a Pro Football Hall of Fame coach.
Joe Gibbs is a NASCAR team owner.
Coy Gibbs was survived by his wife Heather.
Coy Gibbs and Heather had four children.
Ty Gibbs is one of Coy Gibbs and Heather's four children.
Coy Gibbs was a key executive at Joe Gibbs Racing.
Coy Gibbs competed in 39 NASCAR Xfinity Series races (2002–2003).
Coy Gibbs competed in 58 NASCAR Craftsman Truck Series races.
According to a report on Reddit and a statement on NASCAR.com, Coy Gibbs died in his sleep.
Coy Gibbs's death occurred on the same weekend Ty Gibbs won the 2022 Xfinity title.
Ty Gibbs won the 2022 NASCAR Xfinity Series Championship.
